Accepted followup plan: `cooling-diagnostic-fidelity-v2`. No trials executed.

Evidence reviewed:

- Raw: `trial-b70e4553cd9e462492d9b110ce16bbe7` → `run-402cd43df7014d05a4efe6d37b41bd3c`
- Structured: `trial-9c8589a4d93442808431ba65e8403b6d` → `run-45c2192cbdef477d89b13a05c38b6df9`

Both used one baseline and one correction. Baselines passed model checking but failed initialization; baseline behavior was unreported. Both final runs passed model checking, simulation, and behavior. The predicted structured advantage was **not supported**.

Structured feedback omitted 24/29 baseline lines and all 25 correction lines. Tool time was 11.566 seconds raw versus 8.704 structured; one pair cannot establish workflow speed or mechanism benefit. Tokens and costs remain unknown.

The accepted followup is a fresh baseline-only matched diagnostic-fidelity audit costing four runs. Actual initial usage accounts for six runs, leaving six available and two reserved after the proposed followup.

Prior failures and operator recovery were preserved, with missing details explicitly recorded. No new tool errors occurred; no source was accessed. Status reported 38/120 requests and the unchanged deadline.
